summary: Iteration 6: Backend 8/8 pytest PASS. Frontend flows: (a) 'Add Project' fab + empty-state 'Post an opportunity' both navigate to /project/create; (b) full create form fills+submits, POST /api/projects/create returns 200 and the new card appears at the top of the projects list; (c) Discover 'View profile' pill navigates to /profile/{userId} without triggering a swipe; (d) Matches 'View profile' pill AND avatar both navigate to /profile/{userId}; Deal Room pill still present. HOWEVER the profile detail screen (profile/[id].tsx) renders EMPTY — no name, no bio, no skills, no city — only the placeholder image, back button, and footer 'Profile viewed via CoFound' are visible. RCA: GET /api/profile/{user_id} returns the raw user document with fields nested under `profile` (data.profile.name/bio/city/skills/...), but the detail screen calls `setProfile(data)` and then reads `profile.name`, `profile.bio`, `profile.city`, etc. from the TOP LEVEL, so every conditional (`profile.bio ? ...`, `profile.skills?.length > 0 && ...`) evaluates to false and the entire body is skipped. Reference: /app/frontend/app/profile/[id].tsx:61-62. Trivial one-line fix in setProfile to normalize shape (see action_items). Also confirmed: deprecated RN-web warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) still present — same as iteration 4/5.

ui_bugs.issue: Profile detail screen renders NOTHING beyond the hero image because it reads profile fields from the top level of the API response, but backend nests them under `profile` key. All conditional sections (About, Skills, Objectives, Work style, Values, Budget, Languages, hero name/age/city/profession/availability) are skipped. Loading state completes fine, no error is thrown — just an empty screen. Reference: /app/frontend/app/profile/[id].tsx:61-62.

integration_issues.issue: Data-shape mismatch. Backend returns {user_id, email, profile: {name, bio, city, ...}, ...}. Frontend expects flat top-level fields. Fix: `setProfile({ user_id: data.user_id, ...(data.profile || {}) })`.

rca_of_issue: Profile detail empty screen — Root cause: In /app/frontend/app/profile/[id].tsx `load()` (line 57-68), the code calls `const data = await api.getUserProfile(id)` and then `setProfile(data)`. The API (`GET /api/profile/{user_id}` in server.py:274) returns `find_one()` of the users collection which stores all display fields under a nested `profile: {name, bio, city, country, age, profession, skills, experience, availability, budget, objectives, work_style, values, languages, photos}` object. The detail screen reads them flat (`profile.name`, `profile.bio`, `profile.city`, etc.), so every field is `undefined` and every conditional guard (`profile.bio ? ...`, `profile.skills?.length > 0`) short-circuits to false. Reproduction: login, tap 'View profile' pill on Discover or Matches. Expected: full profile card. Actual: only background image + back button + 'Profile viewed via CoFound' footer. Fix (one-liner): `setProfile({ user_id: data.user_id, ...(data.profile || {}) });` — this hoists the nested fields to the top level while preserving user_id for any needed downstream use.
